cohort: 38 preterm infants born at less than 29 weeks gestation
finding: Antenatal magnesium sulfate (MgSO4) administration is associated with a lower SVR and higher myocardial function on day 1 of life in preterm infants born at less than 29 weeks gestation.
mod_finding: This study found that there were no differences in left ventricle function on day 2 between infants who received antenatal magnesium sulfate and those who did not, but there were differences on day 1.
